mechanism: A threshold-checking primitive. Validates if a count of {{ballot}} signals exceeds a required number (K). It does not negotiate; it simply counts. Used as a gating function for higher-level protocols.
failure_modes: Veto threshold tuning is hard - too low enables cheap blocking, too high makes it useless.
Deadline pressure enables rushing bad proposals through.
preconditions: K threshold defined where K ≤ N.

parameters.name: k
parameters.description: Required count of affirmative {{ballot}}s. A count, matching the invariant and preconditions. Sub-majority values are legitimate — an any-one-approves gate is a quorum of 1.
